summary: The compute-matched evaluation protocol ran successfully on both tasks and produced scientifically clear results. The diffusion planning advantage is task-dependent: Dream loses badly on Countdown (-32.5pp vs Qwen best-of-k) but retains a statistically significant advantage on Mini Sudoku (+10.4pp, 95% CI [+6.1pp, +14.6pp]). The protocol successfully reveals that the naive Dream-vs-Qwen-greedy comparison overstates the diffusion advantage by conflating model capacity with inference compute.
analysis: Three conditions were evaluated on 500 instances each of Countdown and Mini Sudoku. Condition A (Qwen greedy): 6.0%/16.8%. Condition B (Qwen best-of-k, optimized, 3 seeds): 39.1%+/-1.4% on Countdown (k=35), 67.2%+/-0.4% on Sudoku (k=39). Condition C (Dream diffusion): 6.6%/77.6%. Bootstrap 95% CIs for Delta=Dream-BoK: Countdown [-36.3%, -28.7%], Sudoku [+6.1%, +14.6%]. Both CIs exclude zero. On Countdown, compute-matched Qwen best-of-k massively outperforms Dream (+32.5pp), completely refuting any diffusion advantage on this task. On Sudoku, Dream retains a significant +10.4pp advantage even after compute matching, supporting a genuine diffusion planning advantage for constraint-satisfaction tasks. The finding is task-dependent and does not meet the strict 'robust advantage on BOTH tasks' criterion, but it does demonstrate a meaningful signal on Sudoku that warrants further investigation.
reason: Verdict is 'good' because: (1) All experiments ran without infrastructure issues and produced complete results for all three conditions on both tasks. (2) The compute-matched protocol reveals a nuanced, scientifically interesting finding: the diffusion advantage is real but task-specific. (3) On Sudoku, Dream beats compute-matched Qwen BoK by +10.4pp with CI [+6.1, +14.6], exceeding the +5pp threshold and excluding zero -- this supports a genuine diffusion advantage for constraint-satisfaction planning. (4) On Countdown, the direction reverses entirely (-32.5pp), showing AR+BoK dominates for arithmetic reasoning. (5) The protocol itself is validated as a useful evaluation methodology that reveals structure the greedy comparison misses. These results are promising and warrant the planned follow-up analyses (sensitivity analysis, scaling curves).
